parts.text: What's the daily meal allowance on a work trip?

For costs incurred on or after 1 July 2026, the daily meal allowance is **£40**. [[S5: "Meals and subsistence | £40 a day"]] [[S8: "cost incurred on or after 1 July 2026"]]

For costs incurred before that date, the previous allowance was **£35 a day**. [[S4: "Meals and subsistence | £35 a day"]] [[S8: "Costs incurred before that date are claimed under version 1.0"]]

You can claim meals when travelling overnight for business or when working away from your usual office for more than 10 hours in a day. [[S2: "travel overnight on business"]][[S2: "more than 10 hours in a day"]]

## 4. Limits

The limits apply per person. Outside the UK, costs in another currency are converted at the rate on the day you incurred them.

| Item | Limit |
| --- | --- |
| Meals and subsistence | £40 a day |
| Hotel, London | £200 a night |
| Hotel, rest of the UK | £130 a night |
| Hotel, Lisbon or Dublin | €180 a night |
| Hotel, other EU cities | €160 a night |
| Client entertainment | £75 a head, approved in advance |
| Team meals (manager-led) | £30 a head, up to once a quarter |
| Home office equipment | £300 once, in your first 3 months |

2e4f37cc-3ccd-414c-96f3-b6d4b479d450.text:
## 1. Purpose

This policy sets out which costs Kestrel Pay pays back when you spend money on company business, the limits that apply, and how to claim. It covers travel, accommodation, meals, client entertainment and small purchases made on behalf of the company.

The policy applies to any cost incurred on or after 1 July 2026. Costs incurred before that date are claimed under version 1.0, even if you submit the claim later.

If something is not covered here, ask your line manager before you spend the money. If your manager is unsure, they should ask the Finance AP team.

## 4. Limits

The limits apply per person. Outside the UK, costs in another currency are converted at the rate on the day you incurred them.

| Item | Limit |
| --- | --- |
| Meals and subsistence | £35 a day |
| Hotel, London | £180 a night |
| Hotel, rest of the UK | £120 a night |
| Hotel, Lisbon or Dublin | €170 a night |
| Hotel, other EU cities | €150 a night |
| Client entertainment | £60 a head, approved in advance |
| Team meals (manager-led) | £30 a head, up to once a quarter |
| Home office equipment | £300 once, in your first 3 months |

1c1a7f94-f2c6-4793-a485-77c60483b536.text:
### 4.1 Meals and subsistence

You can claim meals when you travel overnight on business, or when you work away from your usual office for more than 10 hours in a day. The daily limit covers breakfast, lunch, dinner and soft drinks.

Alcohol is not reimbursed, except as part of approved client entertainment under section 4.3.

If breakfast is included in your hotel rate, the daily limit stays the same.
